summary.description: The plan in a few sentences: what will be built, in what order, why this way, and its risks. It also names each part of the request no item covers, with why; each audit finding you hold wrong, with what shows it; and, after an update, what the change was.

done.description: The plan's definition of done: what holds when this whole plan is built - the request answered, each item's own definition of done met, the repository's checks green. Written as statements a check can answer one by one; the run's final audit holds the round against it.

source.description: Whether the plan was built on one a person gave or made here.

departures.description: Each place this plan departs from a plan a person gave. Empty for a plan made here.

what.description: The part of the given plan this plan does differently, or leaves out.

why.description: The reason, as something a person can check.

items.description: The work items, at most 8. Each is sized to one builder's cycle: as much work as one agent builds whole in a single sitting, with its tests - never more than that, and never a sliver of it. Items run side by side, so none may need another's result.

name.description: A short name for the item: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.

title.description: One line that says what the item delivers; it becomes the subject of the item's commit.

instructions.description: Everything the agent that builds the item needs: what to build, where, what must hold when it is done, and what is out of its scope.

done.description: The item's definition of done: what must hold for the item to be finished, as statements a person or a check can answer one by one - the behaviours built, the test that pins each, and what is true of the tree when the builder reports. The builder works to it, the review weighs it and the run's final audit checks it.

ownedPaths.description: The path patterns this item may write, from the repository's root: a file, or a glob where ** matches any depth (src/Orders/**). No file is matched by the patterns of two items.

forbiddenPaths.description: Path patterns, written as ownedPaths are, that this item must not touch, though they are near its work.

reuses.description: The existing code this item reuses or extends. Empty only where the repository has no machinery related to what the item needs.

path.description: The existing code the item builds on: a file or a directory in the repository.

what.description: What is there, and what the item uses or extends it for.

creates.description: What this item creates from nothing. Empty where everything it does extends what exists.

what.description: The new thing: a type, a service, a helper, a file.

why.description: Why nothing that exists serves, or can be extended to serve.

searched.description: What was searched for, and where, before it was decided that this has to be new.

replaces.description: Existing code this item refactors, rewrites or creates again because the request itself asked for that. Empty where the request asked for none; nothing else that exists is rebuilt.

path.description: The existing code the item rebuilds: a file or a directory in the repository.

what.description: What is rebuilt, and what becomes of the old one: rewritten in place, or removed by this item.

testFilter.description: The filter that names the tests this item's change affects - the test classes that test what it changes, the tests it writes among them; for a runner that selects tests by name, their names - written in what each leg's test runner takes after its filter option, as the task lists them; it names only tests that are there or that the item writes. The engine tests the item on it alone where the run's input affectedTests is on, and every test runs once every item of the round is built. Empty is no filter: every test of each leg runs.

scope.description: What a change a person made while the run worked does to the scope, one piece for each work item it touches, and who has to know. Empty in a first plan, and empty where the change touches no scope.

kind.description: added: work the plan did not have. changed: work the plan had, now to be done differently. removed: work the plan had, that is withdrawn. told: work under way whose scope stays as it is, and that has to know.

item.description: The work item of this piece, in the shape of the plan's items: for added and changed, the item as it now stands in the plan; for removed, the item under the name it had, written for the step that takes it back; null for told.

for.description: For told: the id of the work under way that is to be told, exactly as the task listed it. Empty for the other kinds.

changed.description: What the change means for this piece, written for whoever carries it out or is told, who has none of this conversation. Never empty.

keep.description: What of the work done so far stays as it is. Empty where there is nothing to say.

undo.description: What of the work done so far is taken back. Empty where nothing is.

instead.description: What is done in its place. Empty where nothing is.

preExisting.description: Issues you met that were there before this run - outside what it changed - each reported and never fixed by you. Empty where you met none.

title.description: One line: what is wrong, and where.

description.description: What is wrong and what it causes, as you saw it.

where.description: The paths, from the repository's root, or the command.

evidence.description: What you read or ran and saw, quoted: the file and its lines, or the command and what it printed.

blocks.description: True only where it stops your own work.
